info.title: Crypto Top-up Service API
info.description: Authenticated product and administrative API for deterministic crypto top-ups.

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Non-empty hexadecimal nonce of at most 32 bytes.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Include deposits created at or after this time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Include deposits created before this time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

get.summary:
Transfers to the account's persistent addresses seen above the finalized head. These are not
deposits and have not been credited; once final they leave this list and appear under
`deposits`, and a reorg can remove them.

409.description: `conflict`: the lock is consumed or expired; `window_closed`: the payment window has closed while the lock awaits chain-time expiry; `pending_payment`: the lock address already received a payment.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `(created_at, id)` cursor returned by the previous support page.

confirmation_evidence.description: Most recent confirmation evidence, when checked.

tx_hash.description: Recorded treasury transaction hash, when present.

AttestationResponse.description: TDX evidence binding a nonce to the settlement public key.

quote.description: Versioned dstack attestation bytes as lowercase hexadecimal.

report_data.description: SHA-256 report data as lowercase hexadecimal.

settlement_pubkey.description: Raw ed25519 settlement public key as lowercase hexadecimal.

CancelRateLockResponse.description: Cancellation result for an unpaid rate lock.

CreateRateLockRequest.description: Rate-lock creation body owned by C10.

amount_atomic.description: Desired token amount in atomic units.

amount_minor.description: Desired destination amount in minor units.

DailyReportResponse.description: Daily finance report produced by C12.

exposure_minor.description:
Open rate-lock credit across all products in destination minor units, from the global
exposure counter the global cap is enforced against. This service always sends it; it is
optional in the schema so clients also parse reports from servers that predate it.

routes.description: SQL-computed metrics for each configured route.

DepositAddressResponse.description: Persistent deposit address and deterministic derivation inputs.

route.description: Route name governing deposits to this address.

amount_atomic.description: Atomic token amount encoded as a decimal string.

credit_minor.description: Product credit in minor units encoded as a decimal string.

price_scaled.description: Eight-decimal scaled price encoded as a decimal string.

DepositTransitionResponse.description: One immutable state transition in a support timeline.

attempt.description: Retry attempt recorded for this transition.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when exhausted.

ErrorDetail.description: Stable error fields safe to expose to callers.

ErrorResponse.description: Machine-readable error envelope returned by every API failure.

LimitsResponse.description: Configured route limits and currently available exposure.

account_open_minor.description: Per-account open rate-lock cap in minor units.

global_open_minor.description: Global open rate-lock cap in minor units.

min_credit_minor.description: Minimum destination credit in minor units.

product_open_minor.description: Per-product open rate-lock cap in minor units.

reset_at.description:
Earliest payment-window close among open reserved locks; it can be in the past, because
exposure is released only at chain finality, about 15 minutes after the window closes.

scopes.description: Pause scopes to add or remove.

PauseResponse.description: Current scopes after a pause mutation.

PendingDepositResponse.description:
A transfer to a persistent address seen above the finalized head. It is not a deposit, has not
been credited, and may disappear in a reorg; once final it appears under `deposits`.

amount_atomic.description: Atomic token amount encoded as a decimal string.

confirmations.description: Blocks on top of and including that block at the last head scan.

deposit_id.description: Identifier the deposit will have once final.

estimated_final_at.description: Estimated finality time: block time plus 15 minutes.

first_seen_at.description: First time the service saw the transfer.

supported.description:
Whether a route of this product accepts this token on this chain. Only routed tokens are
scanned before finality, so this is false only for a token routed for another product.

PendingDepositsResponse.description: Pending transfers to an account's persistent addresses.

PersistentSaltInputs.description: Inputs needed to recompute a persistent CREATE2 address.

RateLockPayment.description: A payment observed at a rate-lock address.

amount_atomic.description: Atomic token amount encoded as a decimal string.

amount_within_tolerance.description:
Whether the amount is the lock's asset within the lock tolerance; always false on a
cancelled lock.

confirmations.description: Blocks on top of and including that block at the last head scan; `seen` only.

deposit_id.description: Identifier the deposit has, or will have once final.

estimated_final_at.description: Estimated finality time: block time plus 15 minutes; `seen` only.

in_time.description: Whether the block time is at or before `expires_at`; always false on a cancelled lock.

status.description:
`seen`: in a block above `finalized`, provisional and may still disappear in a reorg.
`finalized`: recorded as a deposit; follow it by `deposit_id`. New values may be added.

supported.description: Whether the token is the lock's route asset.

RateLockResponse.description: Rate-lock response shape owned by C10.

amount_atomic.description: Exact token amount in atomic units.

oneOf.description:
The payment to the lock address that the checkout page should show, once one is seen on
chain: the deposit that consumed the lock; otherwise the first payment that would consume
it; otherwise the first payment. Display only: while `status` is `seen` the payment is not
final and nothing has been credited.

remaining_seconds.description: Whole seconds remaining in the payment window; zero once `expires_at` has passed.

salt_inputs.description: Inputs encoded into the rate-lock salt.

status.description:
Stable lifecycle status: `open`, `consumed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`. A lock stays `open`
after its window closes until the finalized chain passes `expires_at`, so a payment mined
inside the window is never reported as expired.

RateLockSaltInputs.description: Inputs needed to recompute a rate-lock CREATE2 address.

RecordRefundRequest.description: Administrative refund record body owned by C12.

tx_hash.description: Treasury transaction hash to verify at finalized.

RefundRequest.description: Refund request body owned by C12.

RefundResponse.description: Customer refund request accepted for finance review.

from_version.description: Address version the caller observed before requesting rotation.

RouteDailyReport.description: Per-route daily finance report produced by C12.

age_in_state_max_seconds.description: Maximum age in seconds keyed by current deposit state.

open_rate_lock_exposure_atomic.description: Sum of unconsumed rate-lock token amounts.

rejected_holds_atomic.description: Rejected token amount still held after confirmed refunds.

treasury_balance_atomic.description: Latest treasury token balance in atomic units, when the chain read succeeds.

treasury_balance_note.description: Balance source or explicit reason the treasury balance is unavailable.

unflushed_balance_atomic.description: Sum of deposits not linked to a confirmed flush.

SupportDepositResponse.description: Deposit facts with the full immutable transition timeline.

SupportDepositsResponse.description: A support lookup page with timelines.

deposits.description: Matching deposits in descending creation order.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when exhausted.

http_message_signature.name: Signature
http_message_signature.description: RFC 9421 ed25519 signature over `@method`, `@target-uri`, `content-digest`, and `idempotency-key` when sent. `@target-uri` is the service's configured public origin (`TOPUP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`) followed by the request path and query, so sign the public URL you call; `Host` and `X-Forwarded-*` headers are ignored.
